_note: Every sentence the UI shows. Tokens: {A}/{a} first creature (sentence start / mid sentence), {B}/{b} second creature, {days}, {n}, {item}, {kind}, {name}.
ui.start: Pick something below, then tap the field.
ui.zoom: Zoom: slide up to come closer
ui.oops: Something went wrong in this world, so it stopped. Tap ☰ to start a new one.
ui.backAgain: Go back again to leave this world.
hint.fav: Kept in ★. Hold it again to take it off.
ui.snap: Snapshot: tap to keep this moment, hold to go back to it
hint.snapTaken: Snapshot kept. Hold the camera button to come back to it.
hint.snapBack: Back to your snapshot. Undo goes forward again.
hint.cleared: The world is clear. Undo brings it all back.
ui.tool: Your tool: {name}. Tap for the Hand.
hint.sprayOn: Spray on: drag to lay a trail of them.
hint.sprayOff: Spray off: tap to place one; drag to look around.
hint.hand: Tap to poke. Hold to pick up. Drag to look around.
hint.land: Drag on the field to paint terrain.
hint.creature: Tap the field to drop one in. Drag to drop lots.
hint.water: Put these in water. Fish dry out on land; frogs, ducks, turtles and crabs can do both.
hint.enemy: Tap the field to unleash one. UFOs beam humans up and drop them back by parachute. Enemies only hunt humans when Safe is off (Powers tab).
hint.weapon: Tap a creature to arm it. One weapon each.
hint.gear: Tap a creature to hand it over. Gear stacks.
hint.build: Tap or drag on the field to build. Bridges go on water.
hint.inspect: Tap a creature to follow how it is doing.
hint.erase: Eraser on: tap or drag over humans, creatures, enemies, buildings, or land to get rid of them.
hint.bless: Tap a creature: nothing can hurt it for 30 seconds.
hint.clone: Tap a creature to copy it, gear and all.
hint.love: Tap near creatures to make them pair up.
hint.freeze: Tap to freeze everything nearby for 8 seconds.
hint.fireball: Tap to burn a small area.
hint.meteor: Tap to drop a meteor. It leaves a crater.
hint.heal: Tap a creature to heal and feed it.
log.died.dried: {A} dried out on land after {days} days.
log.died.spikes: {A} fell on a spike trap after {days} days.
log.died.tower: {A} was shot by an archer tower after {days} days.
log.died.tornado: {A} was swept up by a tornado after {days} days.
log.died.lightning: {A} was struck by lightning after {days} days.
log.died.fireball: {A} was burned by a fireball after {days} days.
log.died.meteor: {A} was hit by a meteor after {days} days.
log.died.quake: {A} was lost in the earthquake after {days} days.
log.perch: {A} landed on an archer tower and is keeping watch.
log.bounce: {A} landed on {B}'s head and bounced off.
log.abducted: {A} was beamed up by a UFO!
log.giveMiss: Tap right on a creature to give it that.
log.safeOn: Humans are safe. Nothing will attack them.
log.petsSafeOn: Pets safe: nothing may hurt a named pet.
log.gentle.off: Gentle is off: hunger can hurt anyone.
log.gentle.humans: Gentle for people: hunger never hurts a person.
log.gentle.everyone: Gentle for everyone: hunger never hurts anyone.
log.rain: Rain! Grass and food grew back everywhere.
log.worldFull: The world is full. Nothing more can be placed until some are gone.
log.clear: A fresh field. Pick something below.
save.failed: Couldn't save. Export this world from the menu to keep it.
save.newer: This world is from a newer version of the game.
save.damaged: This file is damaged, so it could not be opened.
save.opened: Opened a copy of that world.
react.iceBridge: The water freezes hard enough to walk on.
react.crownParade: The chickens line up behind the crown.
react.bounced: The bounce pad throws {a} up onto the tower.
react.snowGolem: The snowman puts on the hat and stands up.
react.lavaSlime: The slime walks into the lava and likes it.
react.foilBeam: The beam slides off the tinfoil hat.
ui.name: Name it
book.nothingYet: Nothing in here yet. Go and do something.
counts.placed: First thing put in the world
counts.title: This device only
hint.village: Paint where the village may build.
react.bellwether: They follow the one with the bell.
log.ashBloom: Flowers grew where the fire was.
react.glassScatter: The lightning ran across the glass.
react.mudShock: The bolt went right through the mud.
react.windCloth: The wind took her umbrella, and her!
react.haloCure: It turned the zombie back into somebody.
react.robotPond: Robots and ponds do not mix.
react.petFetch: The dog ran after the toy.
react.toyLauncher: The bounce pad flings the teddy too.
